title: Quarterly Orbit Map: Hosted API ↔ Model Surface Alignment & Sprint Playbook
creator: Monica Alvarez
project: Hosted API Model Surface Q1 Runway
description:
Purpose: create a defensible, resourced quarterly roadmap (an 'orbit map') that aligns Hosted API surface changes with the model catalog lineup. Outcome is a sprint playbook for the next 6 sprints that balances latency/cost targets, deprecation windows, and canary rollouts. This ticket bundles the cross-functional planning work: prioritization framework, dependency map, staffing slots, and a signed-off canary + rollback checklist.

Context: multiple PMs have proposed feature requests that touch both API endpoints and model variants (structured output hooks, deterministic seeds, and streaming improvements). Engineering capacity is constrained by Dedicated delivery work and a runtime kernel upgrade slated for Feb. We need a prioritized, time-boxed plan with explicit trade-offs (latency vs token-cost), and guardrails to avoid regressions in hosted customers.

Scope (what's in):
- Prioritize and sequence 12 candidate items across the Hosted API and Model Catalog surfaces (e.g., structured output v2, streaming backpressure, default quantization profiles, model deprecation for legacy 7B family).
- Produce sequence of five sprints + contingency, with owners and minimal acceptance criteria per item.
- Create a dependency matrix mapping infra/runtime constraints, Dedicated commitments, Console telemetry needs, and legal/compliance checks.
- Define canary windows, rollback criteria, and feature flags for each deploy.
- Draft PRD fragments and link to workstreams (engineering RFCs, design mocks).

Scope (out of): major Dedicated capacity procurement changes, long-term model research, or on-prem install packaging (those are separate initiatives).
acceptance_criteria: Orbit map doc approved by Eng Leads, Design Lead, and GTM PMs
Prioritized backlog of 12 items with estimated points and owners
Dependency matrix with explicit blockers and mitigation plans
Canary plan + rollback checklist for each high-risk item (3 or more criteria)
Sprint playbook uploaded to Confluence and linked from this ticket
All items have monitoring/alerts defined in Grafana/Harbor dashboards
